name: cengagement-close-date-writable
description: Ruling 70 of prds/prospect-marketing/rulings.md (10-21-26): CEngagement.closeDate was Read-only on crm-test and production with no formula, so every API write was silently dropped (Acl/GlobalRestriction) and no engagement held a close date. Clearing Read-only lets the application stamp the date when an engagement closes and lets staff correct it. Handoff: cengagement-close-date-crm-handoff.md.
